`node --check output/main.js` passed. Smoke runs with `plain.bst`, `alpha.bst`, `unsrt.bst`, and `abbrv.bst`, plus an `.aux` citation, completed with exit code 0. These checks confirm the tool runs; they do not establish byte-for-byte parity with BibTeX 0.99c.
